blocked: real-kernel POSIX recording (pidfd waits, /proc table, SIGTERM delivery): this machine is Windows

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

scenarios: a member that left the group stays tracked; a recycled root pid is never adopted
a root whose token was taken while it was ours owns its links; a different token under its pid does not
a table that cannot be read is unknown, never empty
the group ends on SIGTERM: no SIGKILL, the target gets SIGTERM and a grace
what ignores SIGTERM gets SIGKILL after the grace, and a second round ends the target
a root pid held by another process: the group is not signalled, the observed target still is
a table that cannot be read at the start signals nothing
survivors that outlast every round are reported as not terminated after three rounds
a table that cannot be read after the kill is not a termination
the passive wait looks at every recheck, an unreadable table is not an end, the end is the first empty look
